annotationRationale: The unused color partitions the towers into exhaustive, disjoint cases. Each case counts linear arrangements with indistinguishable copies of each color.
sourceMethod: Followed the official first solution splitting by the omitted color, explaining the repeated-element factorial divisors and evaluating all three counts.

review.mathCheck: Omitting red, blue, or green gives respective counts 8!/(1!3!4!)=280, 8!/(2!2!4!)=420, and 8!/(2!3!3!)=560. These cases are exhaustive and disjoint. The labeling argument correctly removes permutations among identical colors, giving 1260, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of MAA Q17's first solution on page 10. It retains the three omitted-color cases and adds a reconstructible explanation of the factorial denominators.
review.annotationCheck: Both direct concepts are assessed and necessary. The explanation explicitly establishes indistinguishability and why the case counts can be added.
